name: ALLFED (Alliance to Feed the Earth in Disasters)
summary: A research and policy organisation, founded in 2017 and run from Lafayette, Colorado, with a team spread across several continents, that works on feeding everyone after a global catastrophe that blocks the sun or breaks the food supply: a nuclear winter, a large volcanic eruption, a loss of electricity and industry or an extreme pandemic. It studies resilient foods (seaweed, single-cell protein, relocated crops, greenhouses) and keeping trade open, and advises governments on food plans.
